radiation.label: Space Radiation
radiation.description: Total space radiation you have been exposed to during your trip.

countermeasures.Safe: Radiation is low. Keep sleeping in your shielded bunk and check your badge daily.
countermeasures.Warning: Move your work into the thicker middle rooms of the station and eat healthy snacks.
countermeasures.Critical: High radiation! Go straight to the thick water-wall shelter room and message NASA Ground Control.

heartRate.label: Heart Rate
heartRate.description: How fast your heart is beating right now.

countermeasures.Safe: Your heart rate is steady and healthy. Keep up your daily 20-minute bike workout.
countermeasures.Warning: Pause heavy work, drink a glass of water, and open Relax & Games for slow breathing.
countermeasures.Critical: Stop working and rest right away. Use Relax & Games to slow your breathing and send an update to NASA.

sleepDuration.label: Daily Sleep
sleepDuration.description: Total hours of sleep you got in the last 24 hours.

countermeasures.Safe: You are getting great sleep. Keep lights warm and dim before bedtime.
countermeasures.Warning: Turn off bright blue lights 90 minutes before bed, skip coffee, and take a 25-minute nap.
countermeasures.Critical: You need real rest. Skip tricky tasks today and protect a full 8-hour sleep tonight.

boneDensityLoss.label: Bone Strength
boneDensityLoss.description: How much bone strength is changing each month while floating in space.

countermeasures.Safe: Bones are strong. Keep doing your daily squats and taking Vitamin D.
countermeasures.Warning: Add a few extra squat sets on the workout machine and eat calcium-rich foods.
countermeasures.Critical: Do a full 30–45 minute strength workout today and let NASA doctors check your bone plan.

hydration.label: Body Water (Hydration)
hydration.description: How well hydrated your body is inside the dry spacecraft air.

countermeasures.Safe: Water level looks great. Sip one small cup of water every 2 hours.
countermeasures.Warning: Drink 300 ml of water right now (with an electrolyte pack if you have one).
countermeasures.Critical: Stop heavy work and slowly sip 500 ml of water over the next 30 minutes.
